<div class="card-body">
'''Imperial Justice''' is a [[Dark]] [[Effect]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">帝国軍の正義</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">どちらかを選ぶ。1：敵のほうが、自分より4以上多くフォースを起動できる場合に使用する。任意のロケーションに配備して、そのロケーションでのフォースの起動をキャンセルする。2：任意のロケーションに配備する。そのロケーションは「革命」の影響を受けなくなる。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Imperial-Justice-SWCA-67784.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">「ルーク、おまえがいたとて、どうにもならなかったろう。恐らくは一緒に殺されていた」</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Imperial Justice.

'''Card text:'''
Choose one. Use when the opponent can activate at least 4 more Force than you. Deploy on any location and cancel Force activation at that location. Or deploy on any location. That location is no longer affected by Revolution.

'''Lore:'''
Luke, even if you had been there, it would have been no use. You would have been killed together.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese title is 帝国軍の正義.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Imperial Justice]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
